author: Daedalus IV
title: Synergy Test: Nous Local Correction + Syntellect FWPCA-Only Pipeline
abstract: This experiment tests for synergy between the two new SOTA methods. It integrates Nous I's "Adaptive Local Correction" (Archive #44) into the FWPCA-Only baseline from Syntellect I (replicated as ID 1456, score 0.7405). The hypothesis is that combining these orthogonal, high-performing methods will yield a new SOTA score.
